visualCharacteristics.notes: Accessible ARIA tabs (role=tablist/tab/tabpanel, aria-selected, arrow/Home/End keys). default = equal-width uppercase labels over a 4px light rule, active tab has a 4px black bar; below 768px a native select replaces the strip. pills = centered pill buttons (active solid black, inactive 2px black outline), wraps on mobile. Panels may be filled from following sections with Section Metadata 'Tab' = label (nested blocks are loaded by the tabs block).

contentPattern: N rows x 2 cells [label | panel content (optional)]; optional following sections with Section Metadata 'Tab' supply rich panel content incl. nested blocks
